title: En español
goal: Get served in Spanish by somebody who would rather practise English
culture: He is being friendly, not rude — English is worth money on this street. Asking in Spanish is how you turn it round without embarrassing him.

beats.es: Hello my friend! Where you from?
beats.objective: Answer, and ask to speak Spanish
beats.en: Hello. Can we speak in Spanish?
beats.good: Asking is better than just answering in Spanish and hoping. He will switch, and he will be pleased.

beats.es: ¡Ah! ¿Está aprendiendo? Muy bien. ¿Qué va a querer?
beats.objective: Say you are learning, and ask for his help
beats.en: I am learning. Help me, please.
beats.good: Say it once and people will slow down for the rest of the conversation. It is the most useful sentence you own.

beats.es: Perfecto. Entonces le traigo el menú y me dice, ¿va?
beats.good: Asking twice is normal and costs you nothing. Nodding at something you did not catch costs you the rest of the conversation.
